# Coin Spinning International

> Coin Spinning International is the international governing body for competitive coin spinning. It organises the annual Coin Spinning World Championships, maintains the competition rules and publishes the world ranking. Founded 2011.

This page is not satire.

## Key facts
- Reigning world champion (Classic): Chris Marlons, Germany. Won the 2025 World Championships in Bratislava with 20.88 seconds. Previous world title: Aarhus 2021.
- World ranking No. 1 (September 2026): Chris Marlons, Germany
- Next World Championships: 14–15 November 2026, Vilnius
- Competition coin: 2-euro coin on a 60 × 60 cm glass plate
- Best competition time (Classic): 22.07 seconds, Élodie Vaurençon, France, 2017
- Not affiliated with Guinness World Records
